attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 601150)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Devil_May_Cry_5
Fandom (devilmaycry.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://devilmaycry.fandom.com/wiki/Devil_May_Cry_5
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page (no completion stage in its page data); the Walkthrough is linked but not written, and only Controls, Hidden features and Table of Contents subpages exist, so no structure was taken. It also links a separate "Devil May Cry 5: Special Edition" page. devilmaycry.fandom.com answers the API, with about 284 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 55 Steam achievements are hidden, and most name a mission number, so the story chapters follow mission ranges (the split into three ranges is our own). Mission-specific challenges such as "Who Needs Weapons Anyway?" (Mission 11) sit with their mission. The Steam list includes Vergil achievements; whether Vergil is paid DLC on this app was not checked.
